title: Customer-focused regional failure mitigation play and hotfix triage
creator: Priya Sharma
description: Summary: During a partial cross-region network degradation, a subtle KV-cache divergence combined with asymmetric routing caused elevated latencies and 502s for a subset of Dedicated tenants and degraded quality for Hosted customers. This ticket coordinates triage, customer comms, and a two-stage hotfix rollout that fixes leader-election edge cases and adds telemetry for early KV desync detection.
incident_summary: At ~2026-03-01T02:15Z, monitoring alerted a spike in tail latency for region eu-west-1 and increased 502 errors for model-serving nodes. Investigation found a leader-lease renewal race during transient AZ packet loss leading to stale local KV caches and request routing to nodes with incompatible KV views. Impact: ~12 dedicated tenants experienced latency >750ms, a few requests returned stale/incomplete generations; several hosted customers reported timeouts. No customer data exfiltration.
mitigation_steps_taken: Immediate: Enabled per-tenant routing pinning to known-good leader pool for affected tenants.
Traffic: Began progressive traffic draining from eu-west-1 to eu-west-2 for non-latency-sensitive workloads via rate-limited reroute policy.
Fallback: Deployed temporary leader-lease extension to reduce election flaps while investigating.
Customer comms: Sent incident notices to customers with impacted tenant IDs and opened dedicated support channels for P1 customers.
hotfix_plan: Fix: Patch to leader-election backoff and lease renewal to avoid split-brain in presence of packet loss (PR #8142).
Validation: Add integration test that simulates packet loss and asserts KV convergence within 10s.
Rollout: Canary deploy in eu-west-2 (2% traffic) -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated health gates.
Rollback: Canary rollback plan if error rate exceeds baseline + 3x or latency degradation >200ms for 5min.
current_blockers: Need Security sign-off on new lease telemetry (pending SOC review ticket SEC-712).
Loadtest infra requires a temporary quota increase from infra-admins to validate high-concurrency scenarios.
One replication edge case in edge-compat models requires minor model-runtime patch pending review.
qa_and_validation: Synthetic workload reproducer (GH actions) added to e2e pipeline.
Added KV-drift detector to metrics with alert thresholds and ticket auto-creation.
Post-canary smoke tests include: per-tenant latency, 95/99 percentiles, error rates by model family, and sample output validation against gold prompts.
customer_communications: Initial alert (2026-03-01T03:05Z) to affected customers with triage notes and expected timeline.
Follow-up update (2026-03-02) with canary schedule and mitigation steps.
Dedicated customer call scheduled 2026-03-04 17:00 UTC for top 5 enterprise tenants.
postmortem_action_items: Add preemptive KV-convergence checks to regional failover playbooks.
Automate per-tenant priority draining in Console for Dedicated customers.
Ship telemetry dashboard showing age-of-last-consensus for leader leases.
Create runbook entry to escalate to SRE on 'lease-flap' alert with playbook steps and customer templates.
review_notes: Design review (2026-03-03): agreed to minimize lease extension to avoid masking root cause.
Security review requested for new telemetry fields (SEC-712 opened).
PM notes: prioritize customer-facing communication and update SLA impact statements on status page.
